inspection.subject: Cover
inspection.observed: Salon 1080p frame, title, model dimensions and revision footer are visible. Chairs and serving table frame the foreground.

inspection.subject: Plan and finishes
inspection.observed: All six dimension labels, openings, finish swatches, attribution and site verification are visible. Schematic planning footprints.

inspection.subject: Drawing and daylight
inspection.observed: The sketch and rendered halves align at the same cut. The color half uses the CPU proof image.

inspection.subject: Evening lighting
inspection.observed: The darker proof-style view and its footer are legible. The lighting study is illustrative.

inspection.subject: Salon
inspection.observed: The 1080p doorway view, dining detail, two schematic elevations and complete schedule are visible.

inspection.subject: Living
inspection.observed: Both captions, elevations and schedule are visible. The two proof images repeat one view.

inspection.subject: Bedroom
inspection.observed: Both 1080p views, two elevations and all four furniture rows appear above the footer.

inspection.subject: Bathroom
inspection.observed: Doorway and tub studies, two elevations and both schedule rows are complete. Fixtures are schematic.

inspection.subject: Kitchen-dining
inspection.observed: Both proof views, elevations and both furniture rows appear. The lighting remains dim.

inspection.subject: Study
inspection.observed: Both proof views, elevations and both furniture rows appear. The study is dim and minimally dressed.

inspection.subject: Bedroom approach
inspection.observed: Both fixed-camera 1080p images and revision captions display the separate positions. The plan measurements and fit caveat are visible.

inspection.subject: Writing desk
inspection.observed: Both fixed-camera 1080p images show the desk and changed chair position. Measurements and the field-fit caveat are visible.
